description:
Crispy rice chicken salad 🔥 

By far our new favourite way to make rice. Take your rice to the next level with this easy baking hack! 

For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or search “Osta Recipes” in the App Store or Google Play Store ‼️🫶🏽 

The full recipe is on my Osta which is linked in my bio or you can comment “recipe” and I’ll send the link right to you!

Ingredients (for rice + chicken)
* 300g cooked rice
* 2 tbsp sesame oil
* 2 tbsp soy sauce
* 2 tbsp sweet chilli
* 1 chicken breast
* 1 egg
* Breadcrumbs
* 1/2 cucumber
* 1/4 red onion
* 1/2 avocado
* Sesame seeds

Ingredients (for chipotle sauce)
* 1 cup thick Greek yoghurt
* 1/2 avocado
* 1 tbsp cream cheese
* Juice of ½ lime
* 1 garlic clove
* 1 tbsp sriracha
* 1 tbsp paprika
* 1 tbsp salt/pepper

Method:
1. Cook rice and set aside
2. Once cooled, spread on a lined baking tray
3. Coat evenly with sesame oil, soy and sweet chilli
4. Bake at 200’ for 40 mins
5. Flatten chicken breast and dip in egg and coat with breadcrumbs
6. Air fry at 200’ for 20 mins
7. Make the sauce (blend all ingredients above)
8. Slice cucumber, onion and avocado
9. Combine all in ingredients in a bowl and finish with sauce + sesame seeds

Hope you guys enjoy! ⚡️
